profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Jack Henry & Associates
profile.summary:
I’m a friendly, dynamic, dedicated, and focused IT Software Architect and Developer, I have proven success in Software Development, Software Architecture and Software Integrations for businesses on the Financial, Automotive and Telecommunications Industry.

My history includes leveraging strong management and leadership skills as well as an extensive Software Development experience, always supporting the company’s technical and financial goals.

Additionally, I promote collaborative team environments and build solid consensus among diverse software development stakeholders.

I have advanced knowledge of Applications Development, UAT Testing, Implementation, and Support as well as Client Training—demonstrating strong project coordination and key software project deliverables on time and budget.

Proven Strengths:
- Process Automation
- Application Design and Development
- Client-Driven Solutions
- Management of Development Teams
- Process Automation
- Project Management
- Staff/Client Training
- Business Applications Support
- SQL Server Databases
- Front End/Back End Development

Technical Proficiencies:

C# - SharePoint 2007, 2010, 2013, 2016, Online – Nintex – K2 - ASP.Net - .NET Frameworks 1.0, 1.1, 2.0, 3.0, 3.5,4.0,4.5,4.6.2 - WCF - TFS - LINQ - SQL Server 2000, 2005, 2008 and 2014  - HTML - DHTML - XML - Microsoft Access - Excel - JavaScript – JSON - Java - JQuery – IIS  - SSL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• .NET TFS Developer. Main developer of a web-based interface hosted in SharePoint that emulates the behavior of the TFS MTM System and interacts with the company’s Test Management Platform using custom developed APIs. This solution was done from scratch using the .Net object model for TFS and it’s currently being migrated to production.

Technologies: Microsoft Office SharePoint Server 2016, SharePoint Online, SharePoint Designer 2013, Visual Studio 2015/2017, IIS, SQL Databases/Data Warehouse, .Net, JavaScript, Web Design/Development, REST/SOAP Services, AJAX.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
• Software Development Manager. Manager of a .Net development team with emphasis on the end to end development and implementation of web based applications. Successfully managed the implementation of the hiring platform for the company’s Amarillo location opening, including the integration of proprietary in-house development with third party applications such as Tax Credit Co, Corvirtus and Outmatch. 
Technologies: Visual Studio 2015/2017, IIS, SQL Databases/Data Warehouse, .Net, JavaScript, Web Design/Development, REST/SOAP Services, AJAX, BI.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer - K2/SharePoint/NINTEX
positions.description:
•	Main Software Developer for the Compensation Offer Request System. A SharePoint/Nintex based automated system used by the HR Department to bring Retail Operations Agents onboard and servicing them through their employment life cycle. This system automates a complex multi layer business process by embedding Business Rules and State/Federal Regulations on each step of the process. This system improved Caliber’s ability to hire top Agents in as little as 1 hour. More than 3600 Agents have come onboard through this system. 
•	Main Software Developer for the Property Solutions Application. A K2/FiServ based automated application used by the Servicing Team to service all the loans that have been defaulted. This Application is used in part as CRM to keep track of all the Agent-Client interactions. It is used by the Agents and Managers to get Real Time Information about the Status of a Loan, giving them the ability to service loans on a faster and more efficient way as the required data is shown on a Centralized User Interface.
•	Main Software Developer for the Employee Award Program: A SharePoint/Nintex based automated system implemented company wide that provides the ability for Caliber Employees to submit Kudos to another Employee by simply inputting the Name and Message and selecting from a list of pre-defined templates. More than 31,000 Kudos have been submitted in a little more than a year since its implementation. HR currently uses this system to keep track of Top Awarded Employees to further recognize their efforts. 
•	The “ACE” program is also being used by the HR Department to keep track of employees’ anniversaries and achievements.


Technologies: K2 Workflows, K2 Forms, SQL Databases/Data Warehouse, Microsoft Office SharePoint Server 2016, SharePoint Designer 2010/2013/2016, Visual Studio 2010/2013/2015/2017, .Net Framework 3.5/4.0/4.5 (C#, ASP.Net, XSL), Microsoft Windows Server, MOSS PowerShell, IIS, NINTEX Workflows, NINTEX Forms, JavaScript.

positions.title: Sharepoint Architect I
positions.description:
Responsible for designing complex Software Applications on a Cross-Platform Environment by directing the Solution Implementation efforts among multiple teams, including Business Owners, System Analysts, Developers, Testers and Third-Party Vendors. 
As a Solutions Architect, I was responsible for conducting high level business meetings to gather Business Requirements to latter translate them into Technical Requirements. I was also responsible for developing and overseeing every phase of the SDLC. 
My main goal was to provide a Comprehensive Solution Design, including the specifications and requirements for every Cross-System Interaction, Database Design, Workflow Design, UI Design as well as being the technical and development lead for the development and implementation phases.  

Technologies: Microsoft Office SharePoint Server 2010/2013 (MOSS 2010/2013), SharePoint Designer 2010/2013, Visual Studio 2010/2013, .Net Framework 3.5/4.0 (C#, ASP.Net, XSL), Windows 7/2008/2010 server (64 bit), MOSS PowerShell, IIS, NINTEX Workflows, SPARX Enterprise Architecture, Axure Pro, XML Spy, SQL Databases/Data Warehouse.

positions.title: Sr. SharePoint Architect
positions.description:
* Administration of the SharePoint Server, including creation, configuration and maintenance of Web Applications, Site Collections, Sites and Services.
* Web Part development and maintenance using Visual Studio 2010 (C#, Server/Client Object Model) and Team Foundation Server.
* SharePoint Solutions Deployment (WSP) by using PowerShell.
* Services configuration and administration using PowerShell.
* Day to day support to end users.
* Workflow maintenance and configuration.
* Sharepoint 2010 Subject Matter Expert.
* Development Leader.

positions.title: Sr. SharePoint Architect / Team Leader
positions.description:
Request Management System and Content Management System

Responsabilities included:

* Administration of the SharePoint Server, including creation and maintenance of Web Applications and Site Collections, Services Configuration, BDC Configuration, maintenance of Active Directory and Deployment of WSP and STP packages. 
* Maintaining constant communication with the Project Manager, Account Manager, Business Analyst and Final Users in order to achieve the established goals in the best possible way and identifying and solving problems in the shortest possible time.
* Creating the necessary SharePoint Lists, Site Columns and Content Types required for the form using Visual Studio 2010 and programming the necessary .XML files.
* Creating and configuring several views of the List Form by using the custom web parts.
* Implementing the required business’ rules using jQuery functionality and integrating it with other custom code through Visual Studio 2010 using Java Script language.
* Developing custom HTML forms with SharePoint designer 2010 to meet the UI requirements.
* Using Microsoft. SharePoint namespace (SPSite, SPWeb, SPList, SPQuery etc.) to access the SharePoint list/ document library values through C# language in Visual Studio 2010.
* Creating Java Script functions to validate the information stored in the form and using SharePoint Web Services to access and use information stored in the platform. 
* Sharepoint 2010 Subject Matter Expert.
* Offshore Team Development Leader.

positions.title: SharePoint Architect
positions.description:
* Solving problems left behind by the other consultants prior to the platform release to the production environment. 
* Working abreast with the Department Manager on an Agile (SCRUM) methodology.
* Reorganizing the site structure according to the best practices of Information Architecture and preparing the platform for a sustainable and ordered growth.
* Created custom SharePoint fields, content types and lists to support the intended platform functionality.
* Created Blogs, Wikis and Team Discussion Forums as specified on the best practices of Enterprise 2.0.
* Web-part configuration and customization (XML, XSL).
* Created and customized the master page using HTML, CSS and jQuery.
* Set up the SharePoint Content Management Systems.
* Set up security according to business’ rules.
* Training of the IT Department and End-Users.

positions.title: Sharepoint Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities included:
•Administration of the SharePoint Server, including creation and maintenance of Web Applications and Site Collections, Services Configuration, BDC Configuration, maintenance of Active Directory and Deployment of WSP and STP packages. 
•Maintained constant communication with the Project Manager, Project Supervisor, Functional Supervisor and Final Users in order to achieve the established goals in the best possible way and indentifying and solving problems in the shortest possible time.
•Created the necessary SharePoint Lists, Site Columns and Content Types required for the form using Visual Studio 2010 and programming the necessary .XML files.
•Created and configured several views of the List Form by using the out of the box Data View Web Part and configuring it through SharePoint Designer 2010 and modifying its behavior with jQuery.
•Implemented the required business’ rules using jQuery functionality and integrating it with other custom code through Visual Studio 2010 using Java Script language.
•Created and mapped supporting document libraries with Visual Studio 2010, making it easier for the final user to upload and access the required documents from the same form.
•Developed custom HTML forms with SharePoint designer 2010 to meet the UI requirements.
•Programmed on JavaScript language to satisfy different requirements described on the business’ rules using Visual Studio 2010.
•Debugged problems by using Firefox Developer Tools.
•Used Microsoft. SharePoint namespace (SPSite, SPWeb, SPList, SPQuery etc.) to access the SharePoint list/ document library values through C# language in Visual Studio 2010.
•Created Java Script functions to validate the information stored in the form and used SharePoint Web Services to access and use information stored in the platform.

positions.title: SharePoint Architect/SME
positions.description:
Played a key role as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) and Architect for the implementation of the new AGCO Corporate Global Intranet (iAGCO), using SharePoint 2010. The main goal of this platform is to improve the communication with and among employees. Long term usability, reliability and scalability were key features demanded by the client for this new platform. To address these needs the “Work, Life and Career, and Our Company” Information Architecture Model was implemented, also the best tools and business practices of Enterprise 2.0 were implemented to help the client to achieve his goal on the shortest period of time and to guarantee a short and long term success.  Blogs, wikis, announcements list and custom Web Parts were used for creating the platform. One of the main features of this platform, is the ability to render a single piece of information (such as news articles) in many different ways; to achieve this many different templates were created using jQuery and by modifying the OOTB .XSL, .XML and .XSLT files, thus separating the information stored on the platform and the way it is rendered.   
For this project the complete site structure, including Site Columns, Content Types, List Definitions, Workflows and Pages, was created using Visual Studio 2010 (.Net Framework 3.5); also SharePoint Designer 2010 was used to handle .HTML, .XSL, .XSLT and .XML files.

positions.title: SharePoint Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities included:
•I developed, customized and migrated Web Parts using SharePoint’s namespaces and object model. Functionality from the 2007 environment was kept, updated or improved according to SharePoint 2010 namespaces and object model.
•Used Microsoft.Sharepoint namespace (SPSite, SPWeb, SPList, SPQuery etc.) and object model to access the SharePoint lists/ document libraries stored information through C# Language in Visual Studio 2010.
•Used the SharePoint 2010 out of the box functionality to get rid of previous Request Management and Incident Information systems, making of SharePoint 2010 the central platform for operations, making it easier for the users to access and manage information.
•Created the complete Site Structure including sites, libraries, list, pages, etc programmatically using the SharePoint DOM. 
•Created a custom master page to reflect Steelscape’s Inc. corporate branding, meeting the marketing department needs using SharePoint Designer 2010 and programming in HTML and CSS.

positions.title: SharePoint Administrator
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
•Created a SharePoint workflow to support the functionality needed for the DPMS, CRM and new selling campaigns. The users where kept informed via a personalized e-mail about the status of the workflow. 
•Automated the process for the selling campaigns. When a new client reaches Axtel’s Contact Center a selling executive fills and submits a customized SharePoint form initiating a workflow, depending on the value of the fields on the form a tasks is assigned either to an installation technician, or to a sales supervisor who will be responsible of keeping in touch with the client and updating the status of the request. On each step of the workflow and on every change on the status the system sends an e-mail to the correspondent persons keeping them updated. If by any reason an action is not taken on the specified period of time, a reminder is sent to the correspondent user. This system allowed the sales department to increase their efficiency by almost 200% (From approximately 150 requests attended per month to about 470).
•Created and administered SharePoint Groups to manage security.
•Created a custom master page to reflect Axtel’s corporate branding, meeting the marketing department needs.

Played a key role as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) and Architect for the implementation of the new AGCO Corporate Global Intranet (iAGCO), using SharePoint 2010. The main goal of this platform is to improve the communication with and among employees. Long term usability, reliability and scalability were key features demanded by the client for this new platform. To address these needs the “Work, Life and Career, and Our Company” Information Architecture Model was implemented, also the best tools and business practices of Enterprise 2.0 were implemented to help the client to achieve his goal on the shortest period of time and to guarantee a short and long term success.  Blogs, wikis, announcements list and custom Web Parts were used for creating the platform. One of the main features of this platform, is the ability to render a single piece of information (such as news articles) in many different ways; to achieve this many different templates were created using jQuery and by modifying the OOTB .XSL, .XML and .XSLT files, thus separating the information stored on the platform and the way it is rendered.   
For this project the complete site structure, including Site Columns, Content Types, List Definitions, Workflows and Pages, was created using Visual Studio 2010 (.Net Framework 3.5); also SharePoint Designer 2010 was used to handle .HTML, .XSL, .XSLT and .XML files.

When a new client reaches Axtel’s Contact Center a selling executive fills and submits a customized SharePoint form initiating a workflow, depending on the value of the fields on the form a tasks is assigned either to an installation technician, or to a sales supervisor who will be responsible of keeping in touch with the client and updating the status of the request. If by any reason an action is not taken on the specified period of time, a reminder is sent to the correspondent user.
